summary.text: Joe Hamm is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 84, which he has represented since December 2020, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A veteran of the Pennsylvania Army National Guard, he previously worked as a borough manager.

paragraphs.text: Hamm graduated from Williamsport Area High School in 2003 and served in the Pennsylvania Army National Guard from 2002 to 2008.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Lock Haven University of Pennsylvania in 2009.
In the 2023-2024 session Hamm was assigned to the House Environmental Resources & Energy, Judiciary, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.
